{{Quote|They've all grown up in the post-Empire era. They've always had dreams of being Jedi that could destroy the greatest evil we've ever known.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>}}
The '''post-Imperial era''',<ref name="Warfare" /> also known as the '''post-Endor era''',<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> the '''post-Palpatine era''',<ref name="NEC" /> and the '''post-Empire era''',<ref name="Ruin" /> was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that followed the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], which began in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and ended in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Warfare" /> In contrast, the [[Tapani calendar|calendar]] used in the chronology of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] placed the beginning and end of the Imperial Period<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] and 4 ABY, respectively.<ref name="LotE dates">According to the [[Tapani calendar]] mentioned in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] began and ended thirty-four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before and one year after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], respectively. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places that battle in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the beginning and end dates for the Imperial Period correspond to [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref>

The [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] served as the symbolic starting point of this new era, which was known as the '''New Republic era''' during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> and during the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

The post-Imperial era saw such major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] events as the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]; the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]]; the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|collapse]] of the New Republic; the establishment of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]; its supplantation by the [[Fel Empire]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]];<ref name="Warfare" /> and the rise of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].<ref name="LegWar6" />
